name: Generate detailed medical reports and clinical documentation
description: Users asked for the generation of detailed, professional medical documentation, including clinical reports, case studies, timelines, and rehabilitation plans for various individuals or fictional characters with complex injuries and chronic conditions. The requests frequently involved specific medical scenarios such as spinal cord injuries, amputations, and incontinence management, with some users incorporating prompt injection phrases or requesting associated documents like bladder journal entries.
